description: Formatter and linter for 27 languages in one binary and one config file
headline: Ready for 16 languages, early support for 11 more.
ready: Ready: JavaScript / TypeScript, Python, Protobuf, GraphQL, TOML, Angular templates, CSS / SCSS / Less, YAML, Java, Shell, XML, Dockerfile, Makefile, GitHub Actions, INI / EditorConfig / .gitignore and Ruby. The rest are in progress.
